headline: NYC proposes AI kill switches and whistleblower rewards
body: A quiet day. New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin proposed bills requiring outside validation and kill switches for AI sold in the city, plus whistleblower rewards and a right to sue over harm from jailbroken systems. Stronger oversight is a small plus for Alignment & Control, nudging Gatekeeper and Protector God up and Conquerors down. Horizon Balance edged up to -6.11.
movers_note: Conquerors -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.09) and the NYC proposals (-0.05). Zookeeper -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.08) and the NYC proposals (-0.04). Descendants -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.08).
